statement_record.book: In the poset case, the two-sided condition `a and b <= c iff a <= b => c` is equivalent to the universal mapping property of an exponential: the transpose of a and b <= c is a <= b => c; the evaluation inequality (a => b) and a <= b follows from the reflexivity instance a => b <= a => b; the converse is equally immediate; and uniqueness of transposes is automatic since hom-sets in a poset are subsingletons.
statement_record.intree: The `Closed` class encodes exactly this pairing: `exp_iso {x y z} : x × y ~> z ≊ x ~> z^y` (the two-sided condition) together with `eval' {x y} : y^x × x ~> y := uncurry' id` (evaluation as the transpose of the identity -- the categorification of Awodey's 'reflexivity instance a => b <= a => b') and `ump_exponents' (f : x × y ~> z) : eval' ∘ first (curry' f) ≈ f`. The thin case is witnessed at Instance/Props.v:94, where supplying only the two directions of the entailment produces a full `Closed` instance with zero remaining obligations.
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker: the two formulations are set up side by side and the thin-case collapse is exercised concretely, but the equivalence is not proved as a lemma. In general (non-thin) categories the library must ASSERT `ump_exponents'` as a class field rather than derive it from `exp_iso`, precisely because naturality of exp_iso is not required; Awodey's remark concerns exactly the case (posets) where that extra field is free.

evidence.intree_statement: Inductive Obj : Set := | One_ : Obj (* terminal object 1 *) | Prod_ : Obj → Obj → Obj (* product x × y *) | Exp_ : Obj → Obj → Obj (* exponential, [Exp_ x y] = y ^ x *) | Zero_ : Obj (* initial object 0 *) | Coprod_ : Obj → Obj → Obj.   (* i.e. exactly the IPC formula formers top, and, implies, bottom, or *)

Inductive Hom : Obj → Obj → Set := | Id : ∀ {a}, Hom a a | Compose : ∀ {a b c}, Hom b c → Hom a b → Hom a c | One' : ∀ {a}, Hom a One_ | Exl | Exr | Fork : ∀ {a c d}, Hom a c → Hom a d → Hom a (Prod_ c d) | Curry : ∀ {a b c}, Hom (Prod_ a b) c → Hom a (Exp_ b c) | Uncurry : ∀ {a b c}, Hom a (Exp_ b c) → Hom (Prod_ a b) c | Zero' : ∀ {a}, Hom Zero_ a | Inl | Inr | Merge : ∀ {a c d}, Hom c a → Hom d a → Hom (Coprod_ c d) a.

Program Instance AST : Category := { obj := Obj; hom := Hom; id := @Id; compose := @Compose; homset := fun _ _ => {| equiv := fun f g => ∀ (C : Category) (A : @Cartesian C) `(@Closed C A) `(@Cocartesian C) `(@Terminal C) `(@Initial C), interp f ≈ interp g |} }

"Equipped with the logical connectives below it is a bicartesian closed thin category — a Heyting prealgebra — modelling intuitionistic propositional logic" ... "The exponential is implication because cartesian closure is exactly the adjunction (R /\ P) |- Q  <->  R |- (P -> Q), the deduction theorem."

statement_record.book: A deductive system for IPC on entailments p |- q: (1) |- is reflexive and transitive; (2) p |- top; (3) bottom |- p; (4) p |- q and p |- r iff p |- q and r; (5) p |- r and q |- r iff (p or q) |- r; (6) (p and q) |- r iff p |- (q => r). The text asserts the system is complete for IPC and equivalent to the Hilbert-style presentations, then derives modus ponens and the usual product/implication axioms from it.
statement_record.intree: Instance/AST.v realizes exactly this rule list as the constructors of a typed term GADT over the formula formers `One_ / Prod_ / Exp_ / Zero_ / Coprod_`: `Id`+`Compose` are rule (1); `One'` is rule (2); `Zero'` is rule (3); `Fork`/`Exl`/`Exr` are rule (4); `Merge`/`Inl`/`Inr` are rule (5); `Curry`/`Uncurry` are rule (6). `AST : Category` (line 127) assembles them, and Instance/Props.v supplies a model.
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker in three respects: (a) PROOF RELEVANCE -- `Hom : Obj → Obj → Set` is a term calculus, whereas Awodey's |- is a relation between formulas, so what is in-tree is the Curry-Howard proof-term version rather than the entailment system itself; (b) the equational theory is not the rules -- `AST`'s hom-setoid is defined SEMANTICALLY, as 'equal under every interpretation into a bicartesian closed category' (line 127 onwards), so the freeness/initiality claimed in the file header (lines 31-37) is asserted, not proved; (c) the meta-claims of the item -- completeness for IPC and equivalence with the Hilbert-style axiomatization, plus the derivation of modus ponens and the implication axioms -- are entirely absent.

gap: Missing: (i) any proof-irrelevant entailment relation `p |- q` on propositional formulas -- the six rules exist only as constructors of the proof-relevant `Hom` GADT (Instance/AST.v:72), never as a deductive system in Awodey's sense; (ii) the completeness of this rule system for IPC and its equivalence to a Hilbert-style presentation, both of which the book asserts (no 'Hilbert', 'modus ponens', 'IPC' or 'sequent' hit in-tree); (iii) the derivations the book runs off the rules -- evaluation/modus ponens, the product axioms, the implication axioms; (iv) the initiality of `AST` among bicartesian closed categories, which the header advertises but does not prove (its hom-setoid is defined by quantifying over all interpretations rather than by the rules).
